name: bopen
description: Draft-only bOPEN repository skeleton for PG-P0 preparation.

scripts.build: npm --prefix packages/kernel-contracts run build && npm --prefix packages/kernel-testing run build
scripts.lint: npm --prefix packages/kernel-contracts run lint && npm --prefix packages/kernel-testing run lint && python3 -B tools/validate_skeleton.py --mode lint
scripts.test: python3 -B tests/run_harness.py && npm --prefix packages/kernel-contracts run test && npm --prefix packages/kernel-testing run test
scripts.validate: npm run build && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run validate:skeleton
